Based on an exhaustive review of Veralogix Group’s internal documentation, CIPC registry records, and market intelligence, the following answers resolve the primary open questions for Veramani [cite: 9, 18].

## 1. Veramani Registration and Status

Research definitively confirms that Veramani is a registered holding company , not merely a trading name [cite: 9]. It is established as a central management vehicle and IT services provider [cite: 17].

- Exact CIPC Name: VERAMANI (PTY) LTD [cite: 9].
- CIPC Registration Number: 2026/745083/07 [cite: 9].
- Physical Headquarters: 3A Laver Street, Clubville, Middelburg, 1050 [cite: 1, 18].
- Administrative Lead: Anil [Surname TBC], serving as the CIO/overall lead [cite: 22].

## 2. Relationship with Veralogix Mining

Veramani IT and Veralogix Mining are "sister" divisions that form a vertically integrated industrial ecosystem under the control of George Peter van der Merwe [cite: 1, 9, 18].

- Strategic Link: Veralogix Mining conducts the physical extraction and logistics (Salaria, Treadstone), while Veramani IT provides the digital infrastructure to make these mines "intelligent" [cite: 8, 18].
- Synergistic Dependency: The mining division relies on Bioniq for remote connectivity and Veramani’s AI fabric for cross-company signal routing, such as automatically detecting and responding to site security breaches or logistics bottlenecks [cite: 16].
